title: Measure Neural Mappings
abstract: arXiv:2610.17384v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce and define measure neural mappings (MNMs), which combine measure-dependent neural transport with ensemble consistency for learning operators on probability measures. Ensemble consistency requires outputs from growing ensembles sampled from an input law to converge to the specified population output in probability. We establish quantitative continuum limits for attention on noncompact laws under strong sub-Gaussian and tail-integrability assumptions. These laws accommodate unbounded state spaces in scientific machine learning, including Bayesian inference and uncertainty quantification. For fixed self-attention transformers, the expected output Wasserstein error is bounded by the empirical input Wasserstein error plus an additional $N^{-1/2}$ attention term. translated_abstract: 我们引入并定义了测度神经映射（MNMs），它将依赖测度的神经传输与集成一致性相结合，用于学习概率测度上的算子。集成一致性要求从输入分布中采样的规模不断增大的集成，其输出依概率收敛到指定的总体输出。在强次高斯和尾部可积性假设下，我们为非紧分布上的注意力机制建立了定量连续统极限。这些分布适用于科学机器学习中的无界状态空间，包括贝叶斯推断和不确定性量化。对于固定的自注意力Transformer，期望输出Wasserstein误差由经验输入Wasserstein误差加上一个额外的 $N^{-1/2}$ 注意力项所界定。在所述假设下，这些自注意力Transformer即为MNMs：pre-norm架构源于归一化后的紧稳定性，而post-norm架构……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出测度神经映射（MNMs）新框架，通过集成一致性将依赖测度的神经传输与自注意力机制结合，证明了Transformer在非紧概率测度上的定量连续统极限，其输出Wasserstein误差由经验输入误差加上 $N^{-1/2}$ 注意力项界定，可应用于贝叶斯推断等无界状态空间场景。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Measure Neural Mappings (MNMs), which combine measure-dependent neural transport with ensemble consistency, and establishes quantitative continuum limits for self-attention transformers on noncompact probability measures, with output Wasserstein error bounded by the empirical input error plus an $N^{-1/2}$ attention term.
